subject: Site quarantine, data residency evidence & retention exception Q&A
messages:
From: Jacob Myers <jacob.myers@fintrust.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: site quarantine evidence and short-term retention exception

Hi Stephanie,

Quick one from our security team. We are initiating a precautionary site quarantine for a subset of our dedicated deployment after suspicious activity was flagged on our tenant. Before we proceed with forensics we need confirmation on a few points from Redwood so Legal and InfoSec can sign off: 

- Can you confirm you can "quarantine" the physical/dedicated region so no cross-region replication or failover occurs for a specified tenant?
- During a quarantine period can you create read-only snapshots and escrow them to an immutable storage area accessible for our forensics team? If so, what is the retention window and the manual/automated deletion process afterward?
- We will likely need a 30-day short-term retention exception on one snapshot for investigation. What is Redwood's process for granting and documenting that exception?
- For final closure we need verifiable erase evidence (checksums, snapshot deletion manifests, and timeline). Can you provide a sample artifact that proves deletion?

If easier, we can hop on a 30-min call. This is time-sensitive — trying to get the legal hold and evidence path in place today.

Thanks,
Jacob
Jacob Myers
Head of Security Operations | FinTrust

1) Please confirm the affected tenant IDs and whether any cross-tenant shared resources are suspected.
2) Will FinTrust require read-only console access to the escrowed snapshot, or will you accept a checksum + read-only copy transfer?
3) Is the 30-day exception purely forensics (single snapshot) or do you expect extended log retention beyond that window?

Immediate responses are fine — we can assemble an evidence packet and a one-page attestation for Legal. I attached our internal 'site_quarantine_runbook.pdf' so you can see the normal ops steps; we will tailor the packet to your needs.

Best,

From: ben_carter@redwood.com

Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: site quarantine evidence and short-term retention exception

Jacob / Stephanie / Laura,

Thanks for the details — operationally we can support FinTrust's request for tenant fintrust-prod-03. Summary of our commitments and artifacts we will provide: 

1) Region quarantine / pinning: we will set a site-quarantine policy on the affected tenant that disables cross-region replication, automated failover, and scheduled evacuations for the specified window. This is a manual policy toggle we perform and log.

2) Snapshot escrow: we will create a point-in-time, read-only snapshot and copy it to an immutable escrow bucket (WORM) in the same region. Access model: we will provide a signed transfer (S3 presigned read-only URL) and a snapshot manifest that contains file-level SHA256 checksums.

3) Retention exception: we can honor a 30-day retention exception tied to FinTrust legal hold HL-2026-11-10. The retention exception will be documented in an attestation PDF signed by Redwood Operations and stored with the snapshot manifest.

4) Erase evidence: when the retention period ends (or earlier if requested by you), we will run the deletion workflow which generates a deletion report (timestamps, deletion job IDs, and a final erasure_manifest.json with SHA256 of the deleted snapshot record and audit log pointers). We will provide the erasure_manifest.json and an S3 lifecycle confirmation.

5) Evacuation / fallback: during the quarantine window we will not perform automatic cross-region failover for the quarantined tenant. If an emergency evacuation is required for platform safety, Redwood will notify FinTrust 2 hours in advance and coordinate a controlled snapshot transfer and documented handover. Emergency evacuations are rare; we will include explicit approval steps with Laura if that path is invoked.

Next steps:
- Stephanie & I will prepare the attestation and snapshot manifest sample by EOD PT.
- Laura, can Legal confirm the wording needed for attestation to satisfy FinTrust?

Attachments: snapshot_manifest_example.json (sample manifest), cluster_map.png (ops map)

Regards,
Ben Carter
Sr. Ops Engineer, Redwood Inference
attachments: snapshot_manifest_example.json, cluster_map.png
